The frozen original contract already states entry at anchor +5, complete observations through +74 and a normal-day denominator conditional on complete sessions. This observation motivated the unit and is not a blinded new finding.
Original and later family aggregate results and V7/V8 2026 aggregates are known. No old economic tape or new candidate price/outcome is an input.

Only original-source function-name/line inventory, file hash and Parquet schema/row-count metadata were read before this declaration. No new timestamp array or relevant implementation body has been inspected for this unit.
questions: What code actually determines original event admission and normal-day coverage, and which required observations occur after the intended entry?

What is directly established about the original raw time field, what follows only from the broker New-York-close convention, and what source-specific historical clock evidence is missing or contradictory?

Under each of the two fixed documented time interpretations, how do causal predecision availability, an exact opening-minute observation, future hold-path coverage and unused overcoverage differ on all source dates?
Which source and causal-design corrections would be necessary before a separately declared original-hypothesis economic correction could be considered?

source_scope.sections: Only imports/constants/input-time handling, load_market/session_anchor/complete_session_events, normal_day_count and event scheduling/structural/run call sites. Read source, never import or execute the old adapter. Price/risk/trade functions and economic output tapes are excluded.
source_scope.producer_trace_limit: Read time/provider/provenance metadata only from the named acquisition receipt. If it directly identifies an in-repository producer, source-only reading may follow that exact path solely to determine time serialization. Do not inspect unrelated projects or execute an acquisition/broker API.

input_read_contract.copy: Materialize only filtered 2024-2025 timestamp values into this unit own raw input. No OHLC, spread, tick_volume, real_volume, opening-state, return or risk column is decoded. Opaque full-file hashing is permitted for identity.
input_read_contract.sorted_unique_grid: Report monotonicity, duplicates and minute-grid defects. Source defects are explicit correction states, not event/date exclusions.

fixed_calendar_comparison.civil_dates: 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31; keep every distinct original-source raw date in the union as the observation denominator, even if no session satisfies any window.
representations: ORIGINAL_DIRECT_UTC: reproduce the declared local-to-UTC schedule, then compare those integer labels directly with original raw time values as the old implementation claims. Descriptive only.

NY_CLOSE_BROKER_CONVENTION: convert each exchange-local instant to New York wall time, add seven wall hours, then encode that naive broker label. This is the already documented nominal convention, not a chosen favorable offset or an automatic physical-UTC certificate.
fixed_calendar_comparison.clock_choice_forbidden: Do not rank the two mappings by greater data supply or economic reaction. No third ad-hoc offset, favorable date exclusion or session/window adjustment.
fixed_calendar_comparison.availability: Pre-context and five completed signal bars are known at anchor+5. Exact entry-minute presence is only a historical proxy for a then-current quote, not a certified first-tick freshness gate. Later minute presence cannot be known then and cannot retroactively select admission or the normal-day denominator.
fixed_calendar_comparison.table: For each source date/session/representation/symbol record missing timestamps in each fixed partition and paired-event completeness. Derive causal-prefix-plus-entry versus full-future completeness counts and excluded normal dates. These are observation slots, never trade signals or profitable opportunities.
fixed_calendar_comparison.daily_source_shape: Describe each symbol/date first and last observed raw label, minute count, and gaps. Separately summarize already-fixed US/EU DST mismatch windows (March and October/November in 2024/2025); no price/volume-based clock inference.

primary_document_scope.dated_lookup: Bounded search for FP Markets 2024/2025 server DST/trading-schedule notices may add direct primary historical support. Distinguish API UTC documentation from broker server-wall convention; one cannot silently prove the other.
primary_document_scope.no_data_acquisition: No new market-price API, broker/account query, paid dataset, external AI request or trading candidate is opened.

judgment_contract.implementation_chronology: Record supported, contradicted or unresolved for actual future-admission/denominator dependency using exact source lines, not just labels.
judgment_contract.readiness: A structurally implementable causal design does not by itself certify raw-clock semantics. Report source readiness and required causal contract changes separately. A corrected economic candidate needs independently defensible raw time authority and its own unchanged economic declaration after a whole-map comparison.
judgment_contract.stop: Close this exact bounded question after complete source/calendar evidence. Inadequate clock evidence remains inadequate; do not change sessions, delete dates, examine prices or extend into a diagnostic framework. No arbitrary numeric retry cap for a necessary parser/serialization/source-reading correction.
judgment_contract.authority_correction: If source confirms a concrete additional original-006 defect, append a narrowly attributable lineage authority note. Preserve old sources, numbers and closures; do not infer profit impact or extend findings to other families without evidence.
judgment_contract.next: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 at closure. No automatic candidate reopening or successor.
